title: Intelligent Circular Insights: reliability-first question answering over Digital Product Passports
description: A neuro-symbolic workbench for querying Digital Product Passports. Every output is an evidence-grounded answer with provenance or an explicit abstention. Two interchangeable backends, switchable per request: a fast path over flat product profiles and published emission factors, and a CE-RISE path over the consortium data models and the WP3 PEFDPP ontology. Vendored CE-RISE data models are separately licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0 in schemas/ce-rise/.
